description: Offene Posten / Forderungen: today's open and partially paid invoices by days overdue on asOf (Stichtag, today or later; due date = invoice date + Zahlungsziel): not due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, over 90 days, each with count and outstanding = gross − paid per currency, plus the top debtors. Use it for dunning (Mahnwesen) or 'who owes us what'; sevdesk_invoices_list with overdueOnly shows the single invoices. Amounts without a usable paid figure are marked approximate or unknown; SR, WKR templates and MA reminders are left out, negative invoices listed apart. Computed by this server from sevDesk records, not a sevDesk report.

asOf.description: Reference day (Stichtag), YYYY-MM-DD, today or later; default today (Berlin). sevDesk only knows today's open items, so a past day is refused; a later day ages today's open items as of that day.

top.description: How many of the largest parties to list per currency.

title: Receivables aging
